zh.title: 初次接触机器人，从仿真开始
zh.summary: 刚开始接触这个机器人这方面，从传统的开始做起，先复现师姐的代码，熟悉整个系统的运行流程。

en.title: Getting Started with Robotics in Simulation
en.summary: I began my robotics journey by reproducing a senior lab member's implementation in simulation. This gave me a practical introduction to traditional robot control and helped me understand the architecture and execution flow of a complete robotic system.
